title: Scoring simulated SAINT input with the pure-R engine
text: define two real baits (BaitA, BaitB) two replicates , plus two controls. Six preys exist; BaitA enriches Prey1/Prey2 BaitB Prey3/Prey4. remaining preys background.
code: simulate_si <- function(seed = 42, mode = c("spc", "int")) {   mode <- match.arg(mode)   set.seed(seed)   preys  <- paste0("Prey", 1:6)   baits  <- c("BaitA", "BaitA", "BaitB", "BaitB", "Ctrl1", "Ctrl2")   ips    <- paste0("IP", seq_along(baits))   cort   <- c("T", "T", "T", "T", "C", "C")    # One row per IP x prey; recover the bait for each IP.   grid <- expand.grid(ipId = ips, preyId = preys, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)   grid$baitId <- baits[match(grid$ipId, ips)]    # A prey is enriched ("signal") only for its true bait; everything else is background.   signal <- (grid$baitId == "BaitA" & grid$preyId %in% c("Prey1", "Prey2")) |             (grid$baitId == "BaitB" & grid$preyId %in% c("Prey3", "Prey4"))    # Draw every quantity in one vectorized call.   if (mode == "spc") {     lambda <- ifelse(signal, ifelse(grid$baitId == "BaitA", 20, 15), 0.5)     grid$quant <- stats::rpois(nrow(grid), lambda)   } else {     mu <- ifelse(signal, ifelse(grid$baitId == "BaitA", 1e7, 5e6), 1e4)     grid$quant <- stats::rexp(nrow(grid), 1 / mu)   }    inter <- grid[grid$quant > 0, c("ipId", "baitId", "preyId", "quant")]   rownames(inter) <- NULL   list(     inter = inter,     prey  = data.frame(preyId = preys, preyLength = 500L, preyGeneId = preys,                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE),     bait  = data.frame(ipId = ips, baitId = baits, CorT = cort,                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)   ) }  si_spc <- simulate_si(mode = "spc") str(si_spc, max.level = 2) #> List of 3 #>  $ inter:'data.frame':   19 obs. of  4 variables: #>   ..$ ipId  : chr [1:19] "IP1" "IP2" "IP4" "IP6" ... #>   ..$ baitId: chr [1:19] "BaitA" "BaitA" "BaitB" "Ctrl2" ... #>   ..$ preyId: chr [1:19] "Prey1" "Prey1" "Prey1" "Prey1" ... #>   ..$ quant : int [1:19] 26 17 1 1 22 22 2 2 15 10 ... #>  $ prey :'data.frame':   6 obs. of  3 variables: #>   ..$ preyId    : chr [1:6] "Prey1" "Prey2" "Prey3" "Prey4" ... #>   ..$ preyLength: int [1:6] 500 500 500 500 500 500 #>   ..$ preyGeneId: chr [1:6] "Prey1" "Prey2" "Prey3" "Prey4" ... #>  $ bait :'data.frame':   6 obs. of  3 variables: #>   ..$ ipId  : chr [1:6] "IP1" "IP2" "IP3" "IP4" ... #>   ..$ baitId: chr [1:6] "BaitA" "BaitA" "BaitB" "BaitB" ... #>   ..$ CorT  : chr [1:6] "T" "T" "T" "T" ...

code: scores_spc <- saintexpress::run_saint(si_spc, mode = "spc", optimizer = "base") scores_spc[, c("Bait", "Prey", "AvgP", "BFDR", "SaintScore")] #>    Bait  Prey AvgP BFDR SaintScore #> 1 BaitA Prey1 1.00 0.00       1.00 #> 2 BaitB Prey1 0.00 0.16       0.00 #> 3 BaitA Prey2 1.00 0.00       1.00 #> 4 BaitB Prey3 1.00 0.00       1.00 #> 5 BaitA Prey4 0.00 0.16       0.00 #> 6 BaitB Prey4 1.00 0.00       1.00 #> 7 BaitA Prey5 0.00 0.16       0.00 #> 8 BaitB Prey6 0.22 0.00       0.22 top_per_bait <- function(df) {   df <- df[order(df$Bait, -df$AvgP), ]   do.call(rbind, by(df, df$Bait, head, 2)) } top_per_bait(scores_spc)[, c("Bait", "Prey", "AvgP", "BFDR")] #>          Bait  Prey AvgP BFDR #> BaitA.1 BaitA Prey1    1    0 #> BaitA.3 BaitA Prey2    1    0 #> BaitB.4 BaitB Prey3    1    0 #> BaitB.6 BaitB Prey4    1    0

title: Scoring simulated SAINT input with the pure-R engine
text: FoldChange column summarizes enrichment estimated background. plot effect-size coordinate (EFC, log2(FoldChange)) BFDR evidence coordinate.
code: plot_volcano <- function(scores, title) {   volcano_data <- scores   volcano_data$EFC <- log2(volcano_data$FoldChange)   volcano_data$neg_log10_bfdr <- -log10(pmax(volcano_data$BFDR, 1e-16))   volcano_data$is_hit <- volcano_data$BFDR <= 0.05 & volcano_data$EFC >= 1    plot(     volcano_data$EFC,     volcano_data$neg_log10_bfdr,     pch = 19,     col = ifelse(volcano_data$is_hit, "#B23A48", "#3D6F99"),     xlab = "EFC (log2 fold change)",     ylab = "-log10(BFDR)",     main = title   )   abline(h = -log10(0.05), lty = 2, col = "grey40")   abline(v = 1, lty = 2, col = "grey40")   text(     volcano_data$EFC,     volcano_data$neg_log10_bfdr,     labels = paste(volcano_data$Bait, volcano_data$Prey, sep = ":"),     pos = 3,     cex = 0.7   ) }  plot_volcano(scores_spc, "SAINTexpress spectral-count volcano plot")

text: Quantitative proteomics data Bioconductor often held SummarizedExperiment, QFeatures object collects several . se_to_saint_input() builds SAINT input SummarizedExperiment preys rows IPs columns: colData gives bait test/control flag IP, rowData gene name prey. put simulated spectral counts QFeatures object: proteins assay converts SAINT input scores : saint_scores_to_se() returns scores SummarizedExperiment preys rows baits columns, one assay per score. Unscored prey-bait pairs NA.
code: counts <- tapply(si_spc$inter$quant, si_spc$inter[c("preyId", "ipId")], sum) prey <- si_spc$prey[match(rownames(counts), si_spc$prey$preyId), ] bait <- si_spc$bait[match(colnames(counts), si_spc$bait$ipId), ] se <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(   assays = list(counts = counts),   rowData = data.frame(preyGeneId = prey$preyGeneId),   colData = data.frame(baitId = bait$baitId, CorT = bait$CorT) ) qf <- QFeatures::QFeatures(list(proteins = se)) qf #> An instance of class QFeatures (type: bulk) with 1 set: #>  #>  [1] proteins: SummarizedExperiment with 6 rows and 6 columns si_qf <- saintexpress::se_to_saint_input(qf[["proteins"]], assay = "counts") scores_qf <- saintexpress::run_saint(si_qf, mode = "spc") top_per_bait(scores_qf)[, c("Bait", "Prey", "AvgP", "BFDR")] #>          Bait  Prey AvgP BFDR #> BaitA.1 BaitA Prey1    1    0 #> BaitA.2 BaitA Prey2    1    0 #> BaitB.5 BaitB Prey3    1    0 #> BaitB.6 BaitB Prey4    1    0 scores_se <- saintexpress::saint_scores_to_se(scores_qf) scores_se #> class: SummarizedExperiment  #> dim: 6 2  #> metadata(0): #> assays(11): SpecSum AvgSpec ... FoldChange BFDR #> rownames(6): Prey1 Prey2 ... Prey5 Prey6 #> rowData names(1): PreyGene #> colnames(2): BaitA BaitB #> colData names(1): Bait SummarizedExperiment::assay(scores_se, "BFDR") #>       BaitA BaitB #> Prey1  0.00  0.16 #> Prey2  0.00    NA #> Prey3    NA  0.00 #> Prey4  0.16  0.00 #> Prey5  0.16    NA #> Prey6    NA  0.00
